summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong Listing Rules reporting ongoing share repurchases. On June 16, 2026, the company repurchased 1,494,400 A shares at an average price of HKD 56.2146 per share. Repurchased shares were held as treasury shares (38,238,928 total treasury shares as of June 16). The company's total issued shares excluding treasury stood at 1,770,184,741. No cancellation or redemption was reported. As a non-US filer, this is equivalent to a US issuer's share buyback program disclosure. Watch for continued repurchase activity and potential cancellation, which could signal a capital return strategy.
